required.quote: An applicant for licensure as a private probation provider shall: (1) have a baccalaureate degree in a program approved by the division in collaboration with the board or have a combination of equivalent education and training as determined by the division in collaboration with the board; (2) submit evidence that a business license to engage in private probation has been issued by the political subdivision of the state in which the applicant intends to establish a business office or offices; and (3) apply for licensure and pay the required fees.

experience_source.quote: An applicant for licensure as a private probation provider shall: (1) have a baccalaureate degree in a program approved by the division in collaboration with the board or have a combination of equivalent education and training as determined by the division in collaboration with the board; (2) submit evidence that a business license to engage in private probation has been issued by the political subdivision of the state in which the applicant intends to establish a business office or offices; and (3) apply for licensure and pay the required fees.

interval_years.quote: Each license issued under this chapter shall be issued in accordance with a two-year renewal cycle established by rule.
interval_years.citation: Section 6 - Term of license -- Expiration -- Renewal.

required.quote: At the time of renewal the licensee shall show satisfactory evidence of completion of continuing education as required under this chapter.
required.citation: Section 6 - Term of license -- Expiration -- Renewal.

available.quote: Subject to Subsections (4) through (7), the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if: (a) the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state; (b) the applicant has at least one year of experience practicing under the license issued in the other state, district, or territory; and (c) the applicant's license is in good standing in the other state, district, or territory where the license was issued.
available.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 302 - License by endorsement.

requirements.value: License by endorsement available if the out-of-state license encompasses a similar scope of practice, the applicant has at least one year of experience under the out-of-state license, and the license is in good standing.
requirements.quote: the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if: (a) the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state; (b) the applicant has at least one year of experience practicing under the license issued in the other state, district, or territory; and (c) the applicant's license is in good standing in the other state, district, or territory where the license was issued.
requirements.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 302 - License by endorsement.

exists.quote: There is created the Private Probation Provider Licensing Board. The board shall consist of five members as follows: (a) one member representing the administrative office of the courts; (b) one member representing the Department of Corrections; (c) two members licensed as private probation providers; and (d) one member from the general public.

definition_quote.value: "Private probation" means the preparation of presentence investigation reports and the performance of supervision services by a private probation provider and funded by a court-ordered fee, to be paid by the defendant, in accordance with Subsection 77-18-105(6)(a)(vii).
definition_quote.quote: "Private probation" means the preparation of presentence investigation reports and the performance of supervision services by a private probation provider and funded by a court-ordered fee, to be paid by the defendant, in accordance with Subsection 77-18-105(6)(a)(vii).

methods_authorized.quote: the preparation of presentence investigation reports and the performance of supervision services by a private probation provider

peace_officer_authority_excluded.quote: A private probation provider does not have the authority of a peace officer.

offense_level_limitation.quote: whose services are limited to minor offenses and misdemeanor violations

presentence_investigation_authorized.quote: "Private probation" means the preparation of presentence investigation reports and the performance of supervision services by a private probation provider

funding_mechanism.quote: funded by a court-ordered fee, to be paid by the defendant

dual_service_prohibition.quote: a private probation provider that is a licensee may not simultaneously provide to a defendant private probation services and other services for which the private probation provider receives compensation, including: (i) mental health therapy services; (ii) education services; or (iii) rehabilitation services.
dual_service_prohibition.citation: Section 9 - Standards of conduct for private probation providers -- Contracts -- Reports.

dual_service_exception_distance_miles.quote: no other licensees that provide the services are located within 50 miles of the defendant's residence
dual_service_exception_distance_miles.citation: Section 9 - Standards of conduct for private probation providers -- Contracts -- Reports.

conflict_of_interest_disclosure_required.quote: disclose any circumstance that may create or give the appearance of a conflict of interest and any circumstance that may reasonably raise a question as to the private probation provider's impartiality
conflict_of_interest_disclosure_required.citation: Section 9 - Standards of conduct for private probation providers -- Contracts -- Reports.

impartiality_required.quote: shall maintain impartiality toward all parties
impartiality_required.citation: Section 9 - Standards of conduct for private probation providers -- Contracts -- Reports.

confidentiality_required.quote: shall maintain confidentiality or, in cases where confidentiality is not protected, the private probation provider shall so advise the parties
confidentiality_required.citation: Section 9 - Standards of conduct for private probation providers -- Contracts -- Reports.

solicitation_on_court_property_prohibite.quote: may not solicit defendants as supervision clients on any property that operates as a court of justice as described in Section 78A-1-101
solicitation_on_court_property_prohibite.citation: Section 9 - Standards of conduct for private probation providers -- Contracts -- Reports.

local_government_overlap_restriction.quote: beginning July 1, 2022, may not provide private probation in a county where an agency of local government provides probation services unless the private probation provider has entered into a contract with the agency of local government
local_government_overlap_restriction.citation: Section 9 - Standards of conduct for private probation providers -- Contracts -- Reports.

business_license_required.quote: submit evidence that a business license to engage in private probation has been issued by the political subdivision of the state in which the applicant intends to establish a business office or offices

monthly_reporting_to_county_sheriff_requ.quote: shall provide a report each month to each county sheriff where the private probation provider provides private probation identifying: (i) each individual currently supervised in the county by the private probation provider; (ii) the crimes each individual supervised committed; (iii) the level of supervision that is being provided for each individual; and (iv) any other information related to the provision of private probation that the county sheriff determines is relevant
monthly_reporting_to_county_sheriff_requ.citation: Section 9 - Standards of conduct for private probation providers -- Contracts -- Reports.

court_notification_of_supervision_requir.quote: notify the court that the private probation provider is providing supervision services to a defendant
court_notification_of_supervision_requir.citation: Section 9 - Standards of conduct for private probation providers -- Contracts -- Reports.

defendant_service_choice_required.quote: provide the defendant a list of all available licensees that provide the assessment, treatment, or other services; and (b) permit the defendant to select a licensee described in Subsection (3)(a) with which to complete the required assessment, treatment, or other services.
defendant_service_choice_required.citation: Section 9 - Standards of conduct for private probation providers -- Contracts -- Reports.

written_informed_consent_required_for_du.quote: the private probation provider obtains the defendant's written informed consent
